name: The Flesh
description: Grow the computer. Organoids compute at three times the PFLOPS per kW of any cabinet, fed and held at 37 °C. Bio Singularity points come only from tissue. Contamination climbs with output, and at 99% corruption the tower absorbs you. Needs Dr. Mel Kiorre's trust, and a tower the flesh will accept.

name: The Garden
description: Let the machine belong to the planet. Sun, wind and sold heat feed your green score, and Green Singularity points come from green-line racks and, at half weight, from the rest, both scaled by that score. A dark, still week costs you. Needs Bea Altasar's trust, and a tower the land will forgive.

name: The Singularity
description: The default. Every rack that is not on another tree feeds the Lattice, and the Synthetic line feeds it twice over. Nothing is closed to you and nothing is asked of you. Luci Ferro will handle the paperwork.
